install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-26b4132a3e9d63d0ada3，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-session-hotkeys 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、导航模式、聚焦搜索，键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-26b4132a3e9d63d0ada3.html
posts.en:
dsh-session-hotkeys is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename, navigation mode, search focus), all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-26b4132a3e9d63d0ada3.html
